name: Production API
script:
date = frappe.form_dict.get("date")
start_date = frappe.form_dict.get("start_date")
end_date = frappe.form_dict.get("end_date")
is_date_range = bool(start_date or end_date)
if is_date_range:
	if date:
		frappe.response["http_status_code"] = 400
		frappe.response["message"] = {
			"status": "error",
			"message": "Cannot use 'date' parameter together with 'start_date' or 'end_date'. Use either 'date' for single day or 'start_date'/'end_date' for range.",
		}
	else:
		if not start_date and not end_date:
			start_date = frappe.utils.today()
			end_date = frappe.utils.today()
		if start_date and not end_date:
			end_date = start_date
		if end_date and not start_date:
			start_date = end_date
		try:
			start_date_obj = frappe.utils.getdate(start_date)
			end_date_obj = frappe.utils.getdate(end_date)
			if start_date_obj > end_date_obj:
				frappe.response["http_status_code"] = 400
				frappe.response["message"] = {"status": "error", "message": "Start date cannot be later than end date"}
			else:
				date_filter = ["between", [start_date, end_date]]
				order = "posting_date desc, posting_time desc"
		except Exception:
			frappe.response["http_status_code"] = 400
			frappe.response["message"] = {"status": "error", "message": "Invalid date format. Please use YYYY-MM-DD format"}
else:
	if not date:
		date = frappe.utils.today()
	start_date = date
	end_date = date
	date_filter = date
	order = "posting_time desc"
if not frappe.response.get("http_status_code"):
	filters = {
		"stock_entry_type": ["in", ["Harvesting", "Receiving"]],
		"posting_date": date_filter,
		"docstatus": 1,
	}
	stock_entries = frappe.get_all(
		"Stock Entry",
		filters=filters,
		fields=[
			"name",
			"posting_date",
			"posting_time",
			"stock_entry_type",
			"total_outgoing_value",
			"total_incoming_value",
			"custom_farm",
			"custom_stem_length",
			"custom_location",
			"custom_bucket_id",
			"custom_received_bucket_id",
			"remarks",
		],
		order_by=order,
	)
	harvest_receive_data = []
	for entry in stock_entries:
		stock_entry_doc = frappe.get_doc("Stock Entry", entry.name)
		for item in stock_entry_doc.items:
			entry_datetime = "%sT%s+03:00" % (entry.posting_date, entry.posting_time)
			record = {
				"id": entry.name,
				"datetime": entry_datetime,
				"posting_date": str(entry.posting_date),
				"posting_time": str(entry.posting_time),
				"entry_type": entry.stock_entry_type,
				"item_code": item.item_code,
				"item_name": item.item_name,
				"quantity": item.qty,
				"farm": entry.custom_farm,
				"location": entry.custom_location,
				"class": item.item_group,
				"stem_length": entry.custom_stem_length,
				"bucket_id": entry.custom_received_bucket_id if entry.stock_entry_type == "Receiving" else entry.custom_bucket_id,
				"uom": item.uom,
				"source_warehouse": item.s_warehouse,
				"target_warehouse": item.t_warehouse,
				"basic_rate": item.basic_rate,
				"amount": item.amount,
				"batch_no": item.batch_no,
				"serial_no": item.serial_no,
				"remarks": entry.remarks,
			}
			harvest_receive_data.append(record)
	frappe.response["message"] = {"status": "success", "data": harvest_receive_data}
